confounds: SINGLE_PASS produced 20 broad contract/design decisions; BLOCK_REVIEW executed 12 predetermined subtasks in four 3-task blocks.
BLOCK_REVIEW had an explicit positive/negative structural harness and separate evidence artifact; SINGLE_PASS had different artifact requirements and a one-path candidate write.
Observed defect counts use different reporting lenses and task shapes, so 5 versus 6 cannot be interpreted as comparative defect-detection rate.
I/O observations use different scopes: SINGLE_PASS reports visible tool-call groups across pre-result work, while BLOCK_REVIEW reports block-interior self-trace.
Neither arm has an independently measured matched wall-clock interval.

dimensions.conclusion: Both completed their own canary contracts.
Both preserve existing allocator/PIN/claim/RETURN authority, create zero durable subtask rows, and avoid CURRENT/baseline promotion.
BLOCK_REVIEW demonstrates that checkpoint review can surface four issues before its final audit; this does not prove those issues would escape SINGLE_PASS on the same fixture.
Counts are descriptive only because fixtures and reporting stages differ.
BLOCK_REVIEW persisted candidate+harness+evidence while SINGLE_PASS persisted one candidate path; differing DoD makes causal overhead attribution invalid.
INCONCLUSIVE. Scopes and telemetry are not homologous.
No external matched timing exists; speed cannot select a winner.
Both have useful structural evidence; BLOCK_REVIEW has stronger evidence specifically for its checkpoint contract, not for global superiority.

supported_findings: Both variants can package substantial local work while preserving worker authority and zero durable rows per local subtask.
BLOCK_REVIEW provides direct within-arm evidence that intermediate checkpoints can intercept and repair defects before the final audit.
The current pair cannot establish comparative quality, I/O efficiency, throughput, or superiority because the fixtures and measurement scopes are not matched.
unsupported_claims: SINGLE_PASS is more efficient than BLOCK_REVIEW.

next_evidence_gate.rationale: LOCAL-BATCH-E5-01 is a closer matched-fixture multi-replica design and already has a prerequisite-gated comparison successor; no duplicate experiment job is created here.

truth_boundary: Candidate comparison only. No WORKER_PIPELINE, wc, CURRENT, Served, Human Accepted, or worker-strategy binding is changed.
